title: Marco Falls For Demon Ex Traps
youtube_tags: star vs the forces of evil

series.summary: Desperate to attend the sold-out Mackie Hand movie marathon, Marco is surprised when Stars demon ex-boyfriend Tom pulls up in an extravagant carriage offering an extra ticket. Star insists it is a dangerous trap, but Tom claims he has changed his wicked ways and genuinely wants to be friends. Inside the dragon-drawn vehicle, Tom showers Marco with royal comforts and Swedish kung fu trivia, winning him over until Marco suspects a deeper motive behind Toms suspicious generosity.

cuts.voiceover_text: Marco is having the worst day of his life. His martial arts idol Mackie Hand is dead, and the tribute marathon just sold out in seconds. He is completely devastated.
Right when all hope seems lost, Stars demonic ex-boyfriend Tom pulls up in a blazing carriage. He flaunts two front-row tickets, promising he has given up his wicked ways just to be Marcos friend.

Marco expects a brutal trap and grills Tom on obscure Swedish kung fu lore. Incredibly, Tom nails every single detail. Marco drops his guard, unaware that Tom is counting down the seconds to a much darker scheme.
